T0_same_hole_share: Description of the stored detections of the registered baseline (cache/extension_v16e, unchanged). An image has a same-hole detection when the two detected points are less than 100 px apart (the threshold named by the review). Reported: share of such images among the TEST images and among the TRAIN images of every split, the five-fold out-of-fold TEST total (7,104 images) and the temporal TEST total; number of TEST doors in which more than half of the images have a same-hole detection.

T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.what: Post-hoc diagnostic, not a registered baseline: the template-matching detection of extension_v16e with one added condition, everything else unchanged (templates, common search region, candidates, selection rule, scale fit, CAD list, 30 mm rule, door vote).
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.rule: For the two corner-hole keys the response map is, as before, the maximum over that key's templates of the normalised cross-correlation in the common search region. Instead of taking the maximum of each map independently, the pair (one position per key) with the largest SUM of the two responses is taken among all pairs whose horizontal distance is at least 500 px. 500 px is the separation already written in the registered LoG candidates of extension_v16e; the smallest annotated hole-to-hole distance is 622 px. If the region is not wider than 500 px there is no detection.
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.candidates: The ten candidates of extension_v16e in the same order: six NCC settings (r = 16, 24, 32; m = 40, 80) with the rule above, four LoG settings unchanged (they already carry the 500 px rule).
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.selection: Per split: highest PCK8 on the validation field annotations, ties by lower median error, then earlier candidate (as extension_v16e). No TEST image or TEST label is used.
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.scale: S is fitted again from this diagnostic's own detections on the TRAIN sessions of the split (door8.geometry.fit_scale, median of session medians), not taken from the learned detector.
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.evaluation: Five folds (361 out-of-fold doors, 7,104 images) and the temporal split (133 doors): image accuracy and coverage, door counts with Wilson 95% interval, wrong and rejected doors by class, results before / after the camera change, localisation on the test-role field annotations (PCK8, median and maximum error), own S per split, doors on which the diagnostic and the learned field-adapted detector differ, single-thread detection time.
T1_separation_500px_PRIMARY.supplement: The same detections judged with the S of the learned detector of the split (as posthoc_learned_scale.json), reported in the reply document; in the manuscript only if the own S of a split is outside 1,400-1,550 mm.

T2_per_key_regions_SECONDARY.what: The literal form of the review's first suggestion: one search box per corner-hole key (the box around that key's annotations in the field training images of the split, enlarged by m), each key's templates searched only in its own box, maxima taken independently (no separation condition). Same candidates (LoG unchanged), selection, scale fit and evaluation as T1.
T2_per_key_regions_SECONDARY.use: Reported in the reply document. Because the latch-side hole changes side with the class, the two boxes are expected to overlap almost completely; T2 is run to show this with data, not as an alternative to choose from.

W0_plane_distance: Source check of the 1,450 mm used as the unit of the outer-width baseline (extension_v16w: 'the median depth distance of the door plane reported in manuscript v15, section 4.3'; no script that computed it is in the repository). From the stored features of the learned field-adapted detectors (door8 hole pools; plane_z_mm of images with a fitted plane): median over images and median of session medians for (i) the five-fold out-of-fold TEST images (every one of the 361 doors once), (ii) the TRAIN sessions of every split, (iii) the sessions before and after the camera change.
W1_outer_width_train_constant: Sensitivity of the registered outer-width baseline (variant B, class reference widths) to that constant: 1,450 mm is replaced by the median of the session medians of plane_z_mm over the TRAIN sessions of the split (W0 ii); candidate selection on the VAL sessions, references from the TRAIN sessions, 30 mm rule and door vote as registered. Reported: door counts in five folds and the temporal split, the selected candidates, and the number of doors whose decision differs from the registered result.
claim_rule: Everything is reported whatever its direction. The registered rows of Table 3 (template matching 190/361 and 11/133; outer width 285/361 and 109/133) stay. Table 3 gets one more post-hoc row marked * with the T1 result (own S). With N5 = doors identified by T1 in five folds (of 361) and NT = in the temporal split (of 133): (a) if N5 >= 343 and NT >= 126 (95% of each), the manuscript states that template matching with a separation condition identified nearly as many doors as the learned detectors, the sentence of section 4.2 that fixed-region template matching could not reliably separate the 41 mm gap is restricted to the registered setting without the condition (and to the outer width), and the abstract and conclusion give N5 instead of the learned-scale 286; (b) if N5 <= 300, the manuscript states that the failures remained with the separation condition, gives N5, and keeps the sentence; (c) otherwise both the registered count and N5 are given, the improvement is described as partial, and the sentence is reworded to that effect. If T2 identifies more doors than T1, both are given in the manuscript. The T0 share is stated in section 4.2 in every case. W0: section 3.2 states from which data the 1,450 mm comes; W1: the door counts with the TRAIN-only constant are given in the manuscript next to the registered ones.
